body.message:
The listing is the 2BR in Address Opera in Downtown Dubai. It's available from March 29th or April 1st, whichever works for you.

Price is AED 12,999 per month, all-inclusive. That covers everything, furnished, water, electricity, internet, linen, towels. No hidden charges. The only thing separate is a security deposit collected at contract signing.

For a 2-month stay, we'd lock in that rate for the first 3 months, so you're covered at AED 12,999 throughout your time there.

Which date works better for you?
